snippet.title: Waaaaaa: A Prehistoric Adventure (With Aliens) - Full Trailer
snippet.description:
WISHLIST AND TRY THE FREE DEMO ON STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2555000/?utm_source=youtube

WAAAAAA! 🗣️🌶️ It’s the scream you let out when you've had too much chili...or when all your friends mysteriously vanish!

In this prehistoric pixel art adventure, words don't exist. You are a stubborn caveman, a club in your hand, and a lot of courage.

🧩 ZERO TEXT: Communicate only through emojis, icons, and prehistoric grunts. 
 ⚔️ SIMPLE COMBAT: Turn-based fights where instinct and "mazzate" win the day. 
🛠️ SOLO DEV: A labor of love from a solo developer.

#indiedev #gaming #pixelart #retrogaming #notext #waaaaaa
